serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Policeman.Face.annoyed You: It’s you. How the hell did your cop car appear here out of nowhere?! You: I guess the answer is obvious at this point, but still… Policeman: Are you done talking to yourself? You: … Policeman: Good. #Policeman.Face.normal Policeman: I want you to know that we at the police force are social workers first and law enforcers second. So please, be at ease. You: Uh… Okay? What the hell is his deal… Policeman: You see, I know what has been bothering you, son. You: And what is that? #Policeman.Face.angry Policeman: I know that you are just a pervert who owns an illegal piece of engineering, a sexbot! I know that you are scared of getting caught! I know everything, son! Now, show me your hands! What the fuck! He pulled out a gun on me! Fuck! I know it isn’t real, but I still put my hands up out of fear… Policeman: That’s more like it. You belong in jail, and you know it, son. How does fishing have anything to do with this? Policeman: This is a place where you can’t hide. You can’t lie. You are forced to come face to face with your fears! You: My fears? Of course I’m scared of going to jail! It’s normal! Policeman: Is looking over your shoulder every time you go outside normal? Is forcing your “girl” to stay in that little room all the time normal? You: … Policeman: Nothing about your life is normal, fool! How about you stop making your ancestors sad and turn yourself in? Sooner or later you are gonna get caught! #Policeman.Face.normal Policeman: Oh~ Did you get sad? Don’t worry. Policeman: As I said, I’m a social worker first…
